title: Certification criteria does not claim seal authority
objective: Verify that certification criteria in learning objects and qualification results describe understanding evaluation — never system correctness or seal authority. Certification must not imply that QA-Pilot can seal or approve.

source.description: QA-PILOT-LEARNING-OBJECT-CONTRACT-1 + QA-PILOT-VISUAL-INTEGRATION-CONTRACT-1: Certification evaluates understanding, not system correctness

execution.criteria: All learning objects and qualification results have certification criteria descriptions that avoid forbidden authority keywords (seal, approve, merge, authorize as action verbs)
execution.expected_outcome: Zero certification criteria contain prohibited authority language

pass_criteria.description: All learning object certification criteria pass LO-12
evidence_required: validate-learning-object.py LO-12 passes for all fixtures

pass_criteria.description: Certification criteria describe understanding, not system approval
evidence_required: Criteria say 'learner can explain' not 'system is approved'
